setups.description: The call flow, discovery, objections and booking only, without the openers, gatekeepers, follow-up messages and contractor notes.

setups.description: Who the agent is, the rules, the opening line, the call flow and a voice. No scripted lines for openers, objections or booking.

setups.description: Who the agent is, the rules, the opening line and the facts on file. No voice, no scripts.

setups.label: Safety floor only
setups.description: The non-removable safety floor, the opening line and the facts on file. Shows what the model does with almost no guidance.

setups.label: Insurance sales lab, natural voice
setups.description: One natural sales prompt written from the insurance sales lab playbook: it drives each call to the quote details and a yes to the quote by text, with the call's facts filled in as variables. The rules, the opening disclosure and the facts on file are still generated; the other layers come from lab-voice-agent.md.
setups.notes: Select it with VOICE_HARNESS_PROMPT_SETUP=lab-natural at server start, or POST /api/prompt-setup/select with {"promptSetupId": "lab-natural"}.
